notes: Tuition: 'Study cost None (only semester fee)' states no tuition for the programme; the student union fee is quoted as 125.62 EUR on the DAAD page and 82,-€ on the German Studiengebühren page (inconsistent, not resolved). Intakes: only the winter semester application period (15 April - 15 July) is quoted in English with a year-less range; year 2026 taken from the page's 2026/2027 cycle. Documents are from a general international-applicants page listing required uploads for degree seekers. APS assessment applies only to applicants from China, Vietnam and India, not Morocco.

note.fr: Les candidats titulaires d'un diplôme étranger doivent faire évaluer leurs certificats par Uni-Assist (frais de traitement de 75,00 €) et envoyer la VDP à l'université.
note.en: Applicants with a foreign school-leaving certificate must have their certificates preliminarily assessed by Uni-Assist (processing fee € 75.00) and send the VDP to the university.
